notes.title: Katana Stances Now Added!
notes.content:
Katana combat in Falling Limbs now features the following kenjutsu stances:

• 八相の構え
- Hassō no kamae
  - Eight Aspects Stance

• 中段の構え
- Chudan no kamae
  - Mid Level Stance

• 下段の構え
- Gedan no kamae
  - Low Level Stance

• 脇の構え
- Waki no kamae
  - Side Stance

• 胡蝶の構え
- Kochō no kamae
  - Butterfly Stance

• 上段の構え
- Jodan no kamae
  - High Level Stance

Each stance has both a light and strong strike that can be triggered from it


Watch the video and get the latest updates first in the Discord
